def to_roman(n):
    roman = ''
    # Define the value-symbol pairs with subtractive notation
    values = [
        (1000, 'M'),
        (900, 'CM'),
        (500, 'D'),
        (400, 'CD'),
        (100, 'C'),
        (90, 'XC'),
        (50, 'L'),
        (40, 'XL'),
        (10, 'X'),
        (9, 'IX'),
        (5, 'V'),
        (4, 'IV'),
        (1, 'I')
    ]
    for v, s in values:
        while n >= v:
            roman += s
            n -= v
    return roman
